LESSON: POOL SAFETY HYGIENE

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: SWIMMING
Topic 14.1: Pool safety hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Pool safety hygiene. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:
